1.word_for_word: अथ षष्टितमे कृष्णः परिहासेन रुक्मिणीम् । — Then, in the sixtieth year, Lord Kṛṣṇa jokingly addressed Rukmiṇī.; कोपयित्वा ततः प्रेम-कलहे ताम् असान्त्वयत् ॥ — He angered her and then consoled her in a quarrel over love.; रामाराम-जनानन्द-महोदय-विडम्बनैः । — By the irony of Rama, Rama and Janananda.; रुक्मिण्या प्रेम-कलह-च्छद्मनैश्वर्यम् ईयते ॥ — Rukmiṇī’s wealth is disguised as love and quarrel.; स्व-तल्प-स्थं स्व-पर्यङ्क-स्थम् ॥१॥ — in his own bed, in his own couch.
1.translation: Then, in the sixtieth year, Lord Kṛṣṇa jokingly addressed Rukmiṇī. He angered her and then consoled her in a quarrel over love. By the irony of Rama, Rama and Janananda. Rukmiṇī’s wealth is disguised as love and quarrel. in his own bed, in his own couch.

2.word_for_word: वक्ष्यमाणं रुक्मिण्याः श्री-कृष्ण परमं प्रेम सम्भावयितुं तस्योक्तम् एव तत्त्वम् अनुस्मारयति---यस् त्व् इति ॥२॥ — To convince Rukmiṇī of her supreme love for Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is being spoken, he reminds us of the very truth spoken by her: "Whoever is you.
2.translation: To convince Rukmiṇī of her supreme love for Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is being spoken, he reminds us of the very truth spoken by her: "Whoever is you.

3-7.word_for_word: आदौ तावत् त्रिभिः श्लोकैर् मन्दिरम् अनुवर्णयति---तस्मिन्न् इति । — At the beginning, he describes the temple in three verses: in that.; तच्-छब्देनातिप्रसिद्धम् आह । — He said it was very famous by the word tach.; भ्राजन्ति मुक्ता-दामानि तेषां विलम्बाः सन्ति यस्मिंस् तेन वितानेन । — The pearl necklaces shine through the canopy in which they are delayed; विराजिते तृतीयान्तानां विराजित-पदेनान्वयः ॥३॥ — The conjunction of the third person singular in the virajita is by the word virajita.; सुगन्धितया द्विरेफ-कुलैर् नादिते । — It was fragrant and resounded with the sound of two-horned wings.; प्रविशद्भिश् चन्द्र-रश्मिभिः ॥४॥ — with the rays of the moon entering.; निर्गच्छद्भिर् अगुरु-सम्भवैर् धूपैश् चातिमनोहरत्वं दर्शितम् ॥५॥ — The incense coming out of the fire showed that it was very pleasant.; पयसः क्षीरस्य फेन इव मृदुनि पर्यङ्क-स्थे कशिपूत्तमे हंस-तूलिकायाम् उपतस् थे असेवत ॥६॥ — She sat on a soft couch with milk like the foam of milk and sat on a swan's couch in the best of cups.; तद् एवाभिनयति---बाल-व्यजनम् इति ॥७॥ — That is what he acts out as a child’s fan.
3-7.translation: At the beginning, he describes the temple in three verses: in that. He said it was very famous by the word tach. The pearl necklaces shine through the canopy in which they are delayed The conjunction of the third person singular in the virajita is by the word virajita. It was fragrant and resounded with the sound of two-horned wings. with the rays of the moon entering. The incense coming out of the fire showed that it was very pleasant. She sat on a soft couch with milk like the foam of milk and sat on a swan's couch in the best of cups. That is what he acts out as a child’s fan.

8.word_for_word: उपाच्युतम् अच्युतस्य समीपे सा मणि-नूपुराभ्यां रेजे । — She shone with her jeweled anklets near the infallible Lord.; क्वणयती मणि-मयौ नूपुरी कूजयन्ती, तथा अङ्गुलीय-वलय-व्यजनान्य् अग्र-हस्ते हस्ताग्रे यस्याः सा । — She whose jeweled rings ring, and whose finger rings and fans are on her forearms.; वस्त्रान्तेन गूढौ स्थगितौ कुचौ, तयोः कुङ्कुमं, तेन शोणो हारः, तस्य भासा नितम्बे धृता या परार्घ्या अमूल्या काञ्ची, तया च रेजे ॥८॥ — Their breasts were suspended by the end of the garment, their saffron was covered with a necklace of blood, and the shining of the precious gold which was worn on their hips shone with it.
8.translation: She shone with her jeweled anklets near the infallible Lord. She whose jeweled rings ring, and whose finger rings and fans are on her forearms. Their breasts were suspended by the end of the garment, their saffron was covered with a necklace of blood, and the shining of the precious gold which was worn on their hips shone with it.

9.word_for_word:
तां निरीक्ष्य प्रीतह् सन् स्मयमानो हरिर् आबभाषे । — The Lord, looking at her, was pleased and smiled and spoke to her.; कथं-भूताम् ? — How-ever-being?; या लीलया धृत-नर-तनोस् तस्य अनुरूप-रूपा अनुरूपं रूपं यस्यास् ताम् । — She is the one whose form is the corresponding form of the human body that she playfully carries.; यथोक्तं श्री-पराशरेण--- — As stated by Sri-Parashara; > देवत्वे देव-देहेयं मनुष्यत्वे च मानुषी । — > She is a god-body in her divinity and a human being in her humanity.; >
> विष्णोर् देहानुरूपां वै करोत्य् एषात्मनस् तनुम् ॥ — >
> This body of the self is made to resemble the body of Lord Viṣṇu.; [वि।पु। — [V.P.; १.९.१४३] > इति । — 1.9.143] > is.; किं च, अलकैः कुण्डलाभ्यां निष्केण पदकेन अलङ्कृत-कण्ठेन च चतुर्दिक्षु शोभिते वक्त्रे उल्लसन्ती स्मित-सुधा यस्यास् ताम् ॥९॥ — What is more, the nectar of her smile shone on her face, which was adorned in all four directions with pearls, earrings, a coin, a medallion and a necklace.
9.translation:
The Lord, looking at her, was pleased and smiled and spoke to her. How-ever-being? She is the one whose form is the corresponding form of the human body that she playfully carries. As stated by Sri-Parashara > She is a god-body in her divinity and a human being in her humanity. >
> This body of the self is made to resemble the body of Lord Viṣṇu. [V.P. 1.9.143] > is. What is more, the nectar of her smile shone on her face, which was adorned in all four directions with pearls, earrings, a coin, a medallion and a necklace.

11-12.word_for_word: तान् हित्वा नो\ऽस्मान् असमानान् कस्माद् ववृषे वृतवती त्वम् ॥११ ॥ — Why did you leave them and choose us, who are unequal to us?; प्रायशो राजभ्यो जरासन्धादिभ्यो बिभ्यतो भयं प्राप्नुवतः ॥१२॥ — They were often afraid of kings like Jarasandha
11-12.translation: Why did you leave them and choose us, who are unequal to us? They were often afraid of kings like Jarasandha

13.word_for_word: अस्पष्ट-वर्त्मनाम् अविज्ञाताचाराणाम् । — They have unclear paths and unknown behavior.; अलोक-पथम् अस्त्री-पारतन्त्र्यम् । — The path of the world is the transcendence of women.; पदवीं मार्गम् । — The path to the degree.; आस्थिता अनुसृताः ॥१३॥ — They were established and followed.
13.translation: They have unclear paths and unknown behavior. The path of the world is the transcendence of women. The path to the degree. They were established and followed.

14.word_for_word: किं च, निष्किञ्चना इति ॥१४॥ — What is more, it is selfless.
14.translation: What is more, it is selfless.

15.word_for_word: आत्म-समं परस्परम् अनुरूपम् । — Self-equal, corresponding to each other.; जन्मैश्वर्याभ्यां सहिता आकृतिः रूपं जातिर् वा समा । — The figure, form or race, along with birth and wealth, are equal.; भव आयतिः ॥१५॥ — Become a source of income.
15.translation: Self-equal, corresponding to each other. The figure, form or race, along with birth and wealth, are equal. Become a source of income.

16.word_for_word: न दीर्घा समीक्षा विचारो यस्यास् तया ॥१६॥ — She who has no long review and thought.
16.translation: She who has no long review and thought.

17.word_for_word: अथ इदानीम् अपि ॥१७॥ — And now, too.

18.word_for_word: तर्हि किम् इत्य् आनीताहम् ? — So what am I bringing?; इति चेत्, तत्राह---चैद्य-शाल्व-जरासन्ध- इति । — If so, then he argues that Chaidya, Shalva and Jarasandha.; मम मां द्विषन्ति ॥१८॥ — They hate me for me.
18.translation: So what am I bringing? If so, then he argues that Chaidya, Shalva and Jarasandha. They hate me for me.

19.word_for_word: स्मय-नुत्तये गर्वापनयनाय ॥१९॥ — To remove the smile and to remove the pride.
19.translation: To remove the smile and to remove the pride.

20.word_for_word: स्त्रीणाम् अतिदुःसहम् औदासीन्यम् अकामत्वं चाह---उदासीना इति । — The most unbearable indifference and unwillingness of women is called indifference.; गेहयोर् देह-गेहयोर् उदासीनाः, अत एव ज्योतिर्-अक्रियाः ज्योतिः प्रदीपादि तद्वत् साक्षि-मात्रतया क्रिया-रहिता आस्महे वर्तामहे इति ॥२०॥ — We are indifferent to the body and the house, and therefore light is inactive, just as light, lamp and others are inactive, and we exist as mere witnesses, without action.
20.translation: The most unbearable indifference and unwillingness of women is called indifference. We are indifferent to the body and the house, and therefore light is inactive, just as light, lamp and others are inactive, and we exist as mere witnesses, without action.

21.word_for_word: अविश्लेषाद् धेतोः आत्मानम् एव वल्लभाम् इत्य् एवार्थे इव-शब्दः ॥२१-२२॥ — Because of the indifference of the cause, the word 'like' in the same sense means that the self is the beloved. 21-2
21.translation: Because of the indifference of the cause, the word 'like' in the same sense means that the self is the beloved. 21-2

23.word_for_word: चिन्ता-लक्षणम् आह---पदा इति । — He argues that the characteristic of anxiety is the foot.; नखैर् अरुणा श्रीः कान्तिर् यस्य, तेन सुजातेन सुकोमलेन पदा ॥२३॥ — His nails are red with beauty and radiance, and his feet are well-born and tender.
23.translation: He argues that the characteristic of anxiety is the foot. His nails are red with beauty and radiance, and his feet are well-born and tender.

24.word_for_word: सुदुःखम् अप्रिय-श्रवणात्, भयं त्याग-शङ्कया, शोकोऽनुतापः, तैर् विनष्टा बुद्धिर् यस्याः, तस्याः । — It is very painful to hear unpleasant things, fear of renunciation, grief and regret, and whose intelligence has been destroyed by them.; श्लथन्ति पतन्ति वलयानि यस्माद् धस्तात् । — The rings slip and fall from the bottom.; देहश् च पपात । — The body fell down.; विक्लवा अवशा धीर् यस्याः, तस्याः ॥२४॥ — whose patience is disturbed and subdued.
24.translation: It is very painful to hear unpleasant things, fear of renunciation, grief and regret, and whose intelligence has been destroyed by them. The rings slip and fall from the bottom. The body fell down. whose patience is disturbed and subdued.

25.word_for_word: हास्यस्य प्रौढिं गाम्भीर्यम् ॥२५॥ — The maturity and seriousness of humor.
25.translation: The maturity and seriousness of humor.

26.word_for_word: चतुर्भुज इति उत्थापनाश्लेषण-वक्त्र-परिमार्जनाद्य्-अर्थम् आविष्कृत-चतुर्भुज इत्य् अर्थः । — The four-armed means the four-armed invented for the purpose of lifting, hugging, wiping the face, etc.; समुह्य निबध्य ॥२६॥ — collectively and bound.
26.translation: The four-armed means the four-armed invented for the purpose of lifting, hugging, wiping the face, etc. collectively and bound.

27-28.word_for_word: अश्रुकले अश्रुभिः शोभिते । — The tears are adorned with tears.; शुचा शोकाश्रुभिः । — She mourned with tears of grief.; सान्त्वयामास अनुनीतवान् ॥२७-२८॥ — He consoled and persuaded her.27-2
27-28.translation: The tears are adorned with tears. She mourned with tears of grief. He consoled and persuaded her.27-2

29.word_for_word: मा माम् । — Don’t me.; त्वद्-वचः \"किं नु वदिष्यसि\" इति श्रोतु-कामेन श्रोतुम् इच्छता क्ष्वेल्या नर्मणा एवम् आचरितम् उक्तं, न तत्त्वतः । — Your words, \"what are you going to say\", were said to be done in a joking way, not really.; हे अङ्गने ! — O Angana!; सुन्दरि ! — Beautiful!; ॥२९॥ — ॥29॥
29.translation: Don’t me. Your words, \"what are you going to say\", were said to be done in a joking way, not really. O Angana! Beautiful! ॥29॥

30-31.word_for_word: प्रेम-संरम्भेण प्रणय-कोपेन स्फुरितः कम्पितोऽधरो यस्मिंस् तत् । — That in which his lips trembled with anger and rage of love; कटाक्षास् तैर् आक्षेपैर् अरुणाव् अपाङ्गौ यस्मिंस् तत् । — The glances were those objections that made Aruna’s limbs crippled.; अत एव सुन्दरं कुटिलं भ्रुकुटी-तटं यस्मिंस् तत् ॥३०॥ — That is why it is so beautiful with its crooked banks of eyebrows; ननु कलहे किं कौतुकं सुखं वा ? — Indeed, what is curiosity or pleasure in quarreling?; अत आह---अयं हि इति । — Therefore, he argues, this is it.; नर्मैर् नर्मभिः । — Narmair Narmabhi.; यामः कालः ॥३१॥ — Yama is the time.
30-31.translation: That in which his lips trembled with anger and rage of love The glances were those objections that made Aruna’s limbs crippled. That is why it is so beautiful with its crooked banks of eyebrows Indeed, what is curiosity or pleasure in quarreling? Therefore, he argues, this is it. Narmair Narmabhi. Yama is the time.

32-33.word_for_word: भगवतस् तस्य ऐश्वर्य-युक्तं मुखं स-व्रीडेन हासेन रुचिरेण स्निग्धेनापाङ्गेन वीक्षमाणा ॥३३॥ — She looked at the opulent face of the Lord with a shy smile and a beautiful affectionate eyelid.
32-33.translation: She looked at the opulent face of the Lord with a shy smile and a beautiful affectionate eyelid.

34.word_for_word: असमत्वं भयं दुर्गाश्रयणं प्रबलैः कलिः । — Inequality, fear, and the refuge of the strong are the Kali-yuga.; अराजत्वम् अविज्ञातालौकिकेहावसादनम् ॥ — Non-kingship is the destruction of the unknown worldly world.; निष्किञ्चनत्वं तत्-प्रीतिर् आढ्यानादरणीयता । — To be selfless is to love Him and to be respected by the rich.; अनौचित्यं निर्गुणत्वं वृथा-श्लाघा च भिक्षुभिः ॥ — Impropriety, devoid of virtue, and vain boasting by the monks.; औदासीन्यम् अकामत्वं स्व-दोषान् षोडशासतः । — Indifference and unwillingness are the sixteen rules of one’s own faults.; अज्ञत्वादीर्घ-दर्शित्वे भैम्या राज्ञां बहून् गुणान् । — In his long-sightedness, such as ignorance, Bhīma described many of the virtues of kings.; कृष्णे नर्मोदितान् भैष्मी न्यषेधत् तद्-गुण-स्तवैः ॥ — Bhīṣmī, who was joking about Kṛṣṇa, restrained them by praising His qualities.; भगवता स्व-निन्दा-पराणीव यानि वचनान्य् उक्तानि तानि सर्वोत्कर्ष-परतया व्याचक्षाणा प्रतिभाषते स्म, तत्र यद् उक्तं, कस्मान् नो ववृषेऽसमान् [भा।पु। — The Lord replied to the words which He had spoken as if they were condemning Himself, explaining them with the utmost excellence, saying, Why have you chosen us to be unequal [Bh.p.; १०.६०.११] इति तत्रासाम्यं सत्यम् एवेत्य् आह---नन्व् एवम् इति । — 10.60.11] He argues that the inequality there is true.; हे अरविन्द-विलोचन, त्र्य्-अधीशस् त्रयाणां ब्रह्मादीनाम् अप्य् अधीशो नियन्ता त्वं क्व ? — O Aravinda-vilochan, where are you, the lord of the three, the lord and controller of the three Brahmas and others?; क्व चाहं गुण-प्रकृतिस् त्रिगुण-स्वभावा प्राकृता गुणमयी प्रकृतिर् वा । — Where am I, the nature of the modes of nature, the nature of the three modes of nature, or the nature of the modes of nature?; ननु त्वम् एवाधीश्वरी श्रीः सर्वैर् उपास्यत्वाद् इति चेद् अत आह---अज्ञैः सकामैर् गृहीतौ पादौ यस्याः सा ॥३४॥ — If it is said that Thou alone art the goddess of fortune, since Thou art worshiped by all
34.translation: Inequality, fear, and the refuge of the strong are the Kali-yuga. Non-kingship is the destruction of the unknown worldly world. To be selfless is to love Him and to be respected by the rich. Impropriety, devoid of virtue, and vain boasting by the monks. Indifference and unwillingness are the sixteen rules of one’s own faults. In his long-sightedness, such as ignorance, Bhīma described many of the virtues of kings. Bhīṣmī, who was joking about Kṛṣṇa, restrained them by praising His qualities. The Lord replied to the words which He had spoken as if they were condemning Himself, explaining them with the utmost excellence, saying, Why have you chosen us to be unequal [Bh.p. 10.60.11] He argues that the inequality there is true. O Aravinda-vilochan, where are you, the lord of the three, the lord and controller of the three Brahmas and others? Where am I, the nature of the modes of nature, the nature of the three modes of nature, or the nature of the modes of nature? If it is said that Thou alone art the goddess of fortune, since Thou art worshiped by all

35.word_for_word: यद् उक्तं राजभ्यो बिभ्यतः सुभ्रूः समुद्रं शरणं गतान् [भा।पु। — What was said to the kings, who were afraid and took refuge in the sea with beautiful eyebrows [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१२] इति तत्राह---सत्यम् इति । — 10.60.12] There he argues that it is true.; हे उरुक्रम ! 36.word_for_word: अस्पष्ट-वर्त्मनां पुंसाम् अलोक-पथम् ईयुषाम् [१०.६०.१३] इति यद् उक्तं, तद् अपि तथैवेत्य् आह---त्वत्-पाद- इति । — He argues that what is said about men of unclear paths who have come to the path of the world [10.60.13] is also the same: Thy feet.; नृ-पशुभिर् नराकारैः पशुभिः । — Humans and animals, animals in human form.; किं पुनर् वक्तव्यं ? — What else can I say?; तव वर्त्मास्फुटम् इति । — Your path is clear.; किं च, यस्माद् ये भवन्तम् अनुवर्तन्ते तेषाम् अपि ईहितम् अलौकिकम् इव । — What’s more, because it seems like the intention of those who follow you is supernatural.; अथो अतः किम् उ वक्तव्यं तव ईश्वरस्य ईहितम् अलौकिकम् इत्य् अर्थः । — Therefore, what can u say, that is, the will of your God is supernatural?; आस्थिताः पदवीं सुभ्रूः प्रायः सीदन्ति योषितः [१०.६०.१३] इत्य् अस्य परिहारं वक्ष्यति---यद् वाञ्छया [१०.६०.३८] इति पञ्चम-श्लोके ॥३६॥ — Women with beautiful eyebrows who have established their positions often suffer [10.60.13] He will explain the avoidance of this by saying in the fifth verse that it is by desire

37.word_for_word: निष्किञ्चना वयं शश्वन् निष्किञ्चन-जन-प्रियाः । — We are always selfless and dear to people who are selfless.; > तस्मात् प्रायेण न ह्य् आढ्या मां भजन्ति सुमध्यमे ॥ — > Therefore, O slender-waisted woman, almost no rich woman worships Me.; [भा।पु। — [Bh.P.; > १०.६०.१४] — > 10.60.14]; इत्य् एतच् छ्लोकोक्तं दोष-त्रयं परिहरति---निष्किञ्चन इति । — This avoids the three errors mentioned in the verse: Niṣkincana.; दरिद्रता-लक्षणं निष्किञ्चनत्वं तु तव न घटत इत्य् आह---यस्मा इति । — The characteristic of poverty, however, does not happen to you, he argues, because you are destitute.; अन्यतो बलिभुजः पूज्या अपि ब्रह्मादयो यस्मै भवते बलिं हरन्ति, तस्य सर्वेश्वरस्य भवतो दरिद्रता न घटत इत्य् अर्थः । — On the other hand, it means that even the worshipable Balibhuja, the Lord of all, to whom Brahma and others offer sacrifices, does not cause you poverty.; निष्किञ्चन-जन-प्रियाः इत्य् अत्र तत्पुरुषेण बहुव्रीहिणा वा निन्दा स्याद् इति स्वयम् अप्य् उभयथा स्तौति---प्रेष्ठो भवान् इति । — He himself praises himself in both ways, since he may be condemned by the third person or plural, saying, “You are dear to the poor.”; बलिभुजां ब्रह्मादीनां लोकेश्वराणां त्वं प्रेष्ठः, तेऽपि तुभ्यं तवेति । — You are the dearest of the Lords of the worlds, such as Brahmā, who eat the sacrificial offerings, and they too are yours.; तस्मात् प्रायेण न ह्य् आढ्या मां भजन्ति [भा।पु। — Therefore the rich almost do not worship me [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१४] इति तस्योत्तरं---न त्वा विदन्ति इति । — 10.60.14] The answer is that they do not know you.; आढ्यतयाऽन्धास् त्वा त्वाम् अन्तकं न विदन्ति । — Blinded by wealth, they do not know that You are the end.; अतस् ते असुतृपः असून् एव तर्पयन्ति न त्वां भजन्तीत्य् अर्थः ॥३७॥ — Therefore they are unsatisfied, satisfying only their own desires, and do not worship Thee, that is, they do not worship Thee.
37.translation: We are always selfless and dear to people who are selfless. > Therefore, O slender-waisted woman, almost no rich woman worships Me. 38.word_for_word: बलि-भुजाम् अपि भवान् प्रेष्ठ [३७] इत्य् अत्र हेतुं वदन्ती, ययोर् एव समं वित्तं [भा।पु। — She gives the reason here that you are better than the arms of the sacrifice, [37] who have equal wealth [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१५] इत्य् अनेनोक्तम् अनौचित्यं परिहरति---त्वं वा इति । — 10.60.15] This avoids the impropriety of saying, "Or you.; फलात्मा एरम् आनन्द-रूपः, एतस्यैवानन्दस्यान्यानि भूतानि मात्राम् उपजीवन्ति [बृ।आ।उ। — The fruitful soul is the form of bliss, and other beings live on the quantity of this very bliss [Br.A.U.; ४.३.३३] इति श्रुतेः । — 4.3.33] from the scriptures.; समाजः सेव्य-सेवक-लक्षण-सम्बन्धो, न तु पुंसः स्त्रियाश् च मिथो रतयोः । — Society is a relationship of characteristics between the servant and the servant, not between a man and a woman who are attached to each other.; अत एव तत्-कृत-सुख-दुःखिनोः, तद्-आकुलयोर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३८॥ — That is why it means that they are happy and unhappy with what they have done, and that they are anxious about it.

39.word_for_word: भिक्षुभिः श्लाघिता मुधा [भा।पु। — Mudha praised by the monks [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१६] इत्य् अस्य परिहारः---त्वम् इति । — 10.60.16] The avoidance of this is that you.; भिक्षु-पद-व्याख्यानं न्यस्त-दण्डैर् मुनिभिर् इति । — The explanation of the position of a monk is that the sages have laid down their staffs.; मुधा इत्य् अस्य परिहारः---आत्मा इति । — Mudha is the avoidance of this: the soul.; यद्-अर्थं सर्वं प्रियं भवति, तस्य जगताम् आत्मनस् तव वरणं न वृथेत्य् अर्थः । — This means that Your choice of the Soul of the universe for the sake of which everything is dear is not in vain.; किं च आत्मद इति । — And what about self-giving?; वैदर्भ्य् एतद् अविज्ञाय त्वयादीर्घ-समीक्षया [भा।पु। — Vaidarbhya, not knowing this, you have long-reviewed [Bh.P.; १०.६०.१६] इति स्वस्मिन्न् उक्तं दोष-द्वयं परिहरति---इति इति । — 10.60.16] avoids the two errors mentioned in himself.; इति ज्ञात्वैव मे मया वृतोऽसि इत्य् अज्ञान-परिहारः । — Knowing this, I have chosen you, and this is the avoidance of ignorance.; हित्वा इत्य् अदीर्घ-समीक्षा-परिहारः । — Hitva is the avoidance of a short review.; भगवतो भ्रुवः सकाशाद् उदीरितो यः कालः, तस्य वेगः, तेन ध्वस्ता आशिषो येषां, तान् ब्रह्मादीन् अपि विहाय । — The speed of time, which erupted from the eyebrows of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, destroyed all their blessings, except even Brahmā and others.; कुतोऽन्ये वराका इत्य् अर्थः ॥३९॥ — Where are the other boars, that is, the others?

40.word_for_word: स्वाज्ञानं परिहृत्य पुरुषान्तर-गुण-वर्णन-प्रदीप्त-कोप-संरम्भेण तस्मिन्न् एवाज्ञानम् आपादयति---जाड्यम् इति । — He abandons his own ignorance and, by describing the qualities of other men, becomes angry and inflicts ignorance on himself, saying that he is stupid.; सिंहो यथा पशून् विद्राव्य स्व-बलिं हरति तथा शार्ङ्ग-धनुर्-निनादेन एव जरासन्धादीन् विद्राव्य मां स्वभागं श्रियं यस् त्वं हृतवान् असि तस्य तव राजभ्यो भयाद् उदधिं प्रपन्न इति यद् वचो भाषणं तज् जाड्यं मान्द्यं न घटत इत्य् अर्थः ॥४०॥ — Just as a lion drives away his animals and takes away his sacrifice, so by the sound of the bow of Śārṅga you drive away Jarasandha and others and take away my share of my wealth and I have fled to the ocean for fear of your kings.
40.translation: He abandons his own ignorance and, by describing the qualities of other men, becomes angry and inflicts ignorance on himself, saying that he is stupid. Just as a lion drives away his animals and takes away his sacrifice, so by the sound of the bow of Śārṅga you drive away Jarasandha and others and take away my share of my wealth and I have fled to the ocean for fear of your kings.

41.word_for_word: यच् चान्यत् अस्पष्ट-वर्त्मनाम् इत्य्-आदिना अर्थात् त्वां भजन्तः सीदन्तीत्य् अवसादनं श्रमावहत्वम् उक्तं तद् अपि मन्दम् एवेत्य् आह---यद् वाञ्छया इति । — And whatever else is said to be fatiguing by the words, “They are of vague paths,” that is, those who worship You are suffering, is also slow, he argues, because it is by desire.; यस्य तव भजन-वाञ्छया नृपोत्तमाः । — O best of kings, whose desire is to worship You?; अङ्गो वेनस्य पिता, वैन्यः पृथुः, जायन्तो भरतः, नाहुषो ययातिः, गयश् च आदिर् येषां ते । — Anga was the father of Vena, Vainya was Pṛthu, Jayanta was Bharata, Nahuṣa was Yayāti, and Gaya was the father of these sons.; य एते तव पदवीं मार्गम् आश्रितास् ते किं सीदन्ति ? — What do these suffer who have taken refuge in the path of your degree?; न सीदन्त्य् एव, अपि तु त्वत्-पदं प्राप्ता इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that they are not only suffering, but that they have attained Your position.; एवं कोपावेशेनावसादनस्य परिहाराद् अस्पष्ट-वर्त्मनाम् इत्य् एतद्-आनन्तर्यं विहायात्रोत्कर्षः ॥४१॥ — Thus, by avoiding the descent of those whose paths are unclear by the involvement of anger, this is the continuity of the path of abandonment and the elevation of the journey.
41.translation: And whatever else is said to be fatiguing by the words, “They are of vague paths,” that is, those who worship You are suffering, is also slow, he argues, because it is by desire. O best of kings, whose desire is to worship You? Anga was the father of Vena, Vainya was Pṛthu, Jayanta was Bharata, Nahuṣa was Yayāti, and Gaya was the father of these sons. What do these suffer who have taken refuge in the path of your degree? It means that they are not only suffering, but that they have attained Your position. Thus, by avoiding the descent of those whose paths are unclear by the involvement of anger, this is the continuity of the path of abandonment and the elevation of the journey.

42.word_for_word: यच् चोक्तं अथात्मनोऽनुरूपम् [भा।पु। — What is said, then, is in accordance with the self [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१७] तत्राह---का अन्यम् इति श्लोक-द्वयेन । — 10.60.17] There he says, "What else?"; गुणानाम् आलयस्य तव पाद-सरोज-गन्धं, जनताया अपवर्गं मोक्ष-रूपं, लक्ष्म्या आलयं तत्-सेव्यं, सद्भिर् मुखरितं वर्णितम् आघ्राय तम् अविगणय्य मर्त्या मरण-धर्मिका सदा उरु-भयं यस्य तम् अन्यं का स्त्री श्रयेत सेवेत ? — The fragrance of the lotus of Thy feet, the abode of virtues, the liberation of the people, the form of salvation, the abode of Lakshmi, the abode of Lakshmi, described by the virtuous, who smells it and ignores it.; अर्थे विविक्ता दृष्टिः यस्याः, सा । — She who has a separate vision of meaning.; गुणालयस्य इत्य् अनेन गुणैर् हीना इति यद् उक्तं तद् अपास्तम् ॥४२॥ — That which has been said that she is the abode of the virtues and that she is devoid of virtues is refuted.
42.translation: What is said, then, is in accordance with the self [Bh.p. 10.60.17] There he says, "What else?" The fragrance of the lotus of Thy feet, the abode of virtues, the liberation of the people, the form of salvation, the abode of Lakshmi, the abode of Lakshmi, described by the virtuous, who smells it and ignores it. She who has a separate vision of meaning. That which has been said that she is the abode of the virtues and that she is devoid of virtues is refuted.

43.word_for_word: अतस् त्वाम् एवाहम् अभजम् इत्य् आह---तं त्वा इति । — Therefore, he said, "I have worshiped you.; किं च, प्रार्थयते---स्याद् इति । — What is more, he prays that it may be.; अरणं शरणम् । — The forest is a refuge.; सृतिभिः देव-तिर्यग्-आदिभिर् जन्मभिः । — By the creations, by the births of the demigods, animals and others.; पाठान्तरे त्व् अर्थवाद-बहुल-कर्म-श्रवणैर् इत्य् अर्थः । — In another text, however, it means by hearing the multiple actions of semantics.; कथम्भूतस्य तव ? — How's yours going?; यस् त्वम् अनृतस्य संसारस्य अपवर्गो नाशो यस्मात्, स भजन्तम् उपयाति आत्मसात् करोति, तस्य तवाङ्घ्रिः इति । — You who are the liberation and destruction of the world of falsehood, who approaches and attracts the worshipper, are your feet.; भीतस्य हि शरणम् एवानुरूपं भजन-योग्यं, अतस् त्वाम् अहम् अभजम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥४३॥ — For the refuge of the fearful is the only worthy worship, therefore I have worshiped Thee, that is, I have worshipped Thee.
43.translation: Therefore, he said, "I have worshiped you. What is more, he prays that it may be. The forest is a refuge. By the creations, by the births of the demigods, animals and others. In another text, however, it means by hearing the multiple actions of semantics. How's yours going? You who are the liberation and destruction of the world of falsehood, who approaches and attracts the worshipper, are your feet. For the refuge of the fearful is the only worthy worship, therefore I have worshiped Thee, that is, I have worshipped Thee.

44.word_for_word: ये चोक्ता राज्ञां बहवो गुणाः, राज-पुत्रीप्सिता भूपैर् लोक-पाल-विभूतिभिः [भा।पु। — The many virtues of kings which have been mentioned, the daughter of a king desired by the kings who rule the world and the glories [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१०] इत्य्-आदिना तत्र सेर्ष्ये सशापं साङ्गुलि-भङ्गं चाह द्वाभ्याम्---तस्याः स्युर् इति । — 10.60.10] etc. There I shall be envious of her with a curse and breaking her fingers with two---she shall be.; खरा इव केवलं भारवाहाः, गावो बलिवर्दा इव नित्यं व्यापार-क्लिष्टाः, श्वान इवावमताः, विडाला इव कृपणा हिंस्राश् च, भृत्या इव किङ्करा नृपास् तस्या दुर्भगायाः पतयः स्युः । — Kings who carry only heavy loads like donkeys, cows who are always busy with business like sacrificial animals, humiliated like dogs, miserable and violent like cats, and servants like servants will be the masters of that unfortunate woman.; यस्याः कर्ण-पथं त्वत्-कथा न प्राप्नुयाद् इति ॥४४॥ — whose ears may not reach the path of your story.
44.translation: The many virtues of kings which have been mentioned, the daughter of a king desired by the kings who rule the world and the glories [Bh.p. 10.60.10] etc. There I shall be envious of her with a curse and breaking her fingers with two---she shall be. Kings who carry only heavy loads like donkeys, cows who are always busy with business like sacrificial animals, humiliated like dogs, miserable and violent like cats, and servants like servants will be the masters of that unfortunate woman. whose ears may not reach the path of your story.

45.word_for_word: तथा हि, ते पदाब्ज-मकरन्दम् अजिघ्रती सती या स्त्री विमूढा, सा कान्तोऽयम् इति मतिर् यस्याः सा कान्त-मतिर् जीवच्-छवं भजति । — Thus, a woman who is bewildered by not smelling the nectar of Your lotus feet, who thinks that this is her lover, worships the living image of her lover.; त्वग्-आदिभिर् बहिः पिनद्धं छन्नम्, अन्तर् मांसादि-मयम् इति ॥४५॥ — It is covered with skin and other materials on the outside and covered with flesh and other materials within.
45.translation: Thus, a woman who is bewildered by not smelling the nectar of Your lotus feet, who thinks that this is her lover, worships the living image of her lover. It is covered with skin and other materials on the outside and covered with flesh and other materials within.

46.word_for_word: यद् उक्तं उदासीना वयम् [भा।पु। — We are indifferent to what is said [Bh.p.; १०.६०.२०] इत्य्-आदिना तत्राह---अस्त्व् इति । — 10.60.20] etc. There he argues that there should be.; यद्यपि त्वं निरपेक्षः, तथापि मम ते चरणानुरागोऽस्तु । — Although You are absolute, let me have affection for Your feet.; मयि च मय्य् अपि नातिरिक्ता अतिशयवती दृष्टिर् यस्य, तस्य ते । — You are the one who has an excessive view of Me and Me.; आत्मन् आत्मन्य् एव रतस्य । — He is absorbed in himself and in himself.; तर्हि तव तेन को लाभः ? — So what do you gain from that?; त्वच्-चरणानुराग एव महान् लाभः । — The greatest benefit is the passion for your skin and feet.; किं च, यर्ह्य् अस्य विश्वस्य वृद्धये उपात्ता रजसोऽतिमात्र्आ औत्कट्यं येन, स तथाभूतः सन् माम् ईक्षसे । — Moreover, when the mode of passion, which is used for the growth of this universe, is excessively aroused, you look upon Me as such.; उ एवार्थे । — U in the same sense.; ह हर्षे । — H. in joy.; तद् एव नः परमानुकम्पा अत्यनुग्रह इति ॥५६॥ — That is our supreme compassion and great mercy.
46.translation: We are indifferent to what is said [Bh.p. 10.60.20] etc. There he argues that there should be. Although You are absolute, let me have affection for Your feet. You are the one who has an excessive view of Me and Me. He is absorbed in himself and in himself. So what do you gain from that? The greatest benefit is the passion for your skin and feet. Moreover, when the mode of passion, which is used for the growth of this universe, is excessively aroused, you look upon Me as such. U in the same sense. H. in joy. That is our supreme compassion and great mercy.

47-48.word_for_word: तद् एवं सर्वं तद् उक्तं प्रतिव्याख्याय प्रसन्न-चित्ता मन्त्रम् उपदिशन्त्य् आह द्वाभ्याम्---नैव इति । — After explaining all that had been said in this way, the sage, who was pleased with the mantra, said to both of them, “No.”; अथात्मनोऽनुरूपम् [भा।पु। — Then it is in accordance with the self [Bh.p.; १०.६०.१७] इत्य्-आदि ते वचोऽलीकं मिथ्येति नैव मन्ये । — 10.60.17] I do not think that your words are false.; यतो लोके कन्याया एव क्वचिद् रतिर् भवति । — Because in this world, it is only a girl who is sometimes attracted.; यथा काशिराज-कन्यानाम् अम्बाम्बालिकाम्बिकानां तिसृणां मध्ये अम्बायाः कन्याया एव शाल्वे रतिर् जाता, तद्वत् ॥४७॥ — Just as among the three daughters of the king of Kāśi, Amba, Amba and Ambika, only the daughter of Amba became attracted to Śālva.; व्यूढायाः परिणीताया अपि इति । — Even for a married woman who is married.; उभयस्माद् इह-पर-लोक-द्वयाच् च्युतो भ्रष्ट इति ॥४८॥ — He is fallen from both this world and the next, and he is destroyed.
47-48.translation: After explaining all that had been said in this way, the sage, who was pleased with the mantra, said to both of them, “No.” Then it is in accordance with the self [Bh.p. 10.60.17] I do not think that your words are false. Because in this world, it is only a girl who is sometimes attracted. Just as among the three daughters of the king of Kāśi, Amba, Amba and Ambika, only the daughter of Amba became attracted to Śālva. Even for a married woman who is married. He is fallen from both this world and the next, and he is destroyed.

49.word_for_word: प्रलम्भिता उपहसिता । — She was delayed and laughed at.; अन्वात्थ अन्वाख्यातवती ॥४९॥ — Anvattha Anvakhyatavati.
49.translation: She was delayed and laughed at. Anvattha Anvakhyatavati.

50.word_for_word: मयि एकान्त-भक्तायास् ते कामाः सन्त्य् एव । — Those desires are already present in Me, the solitary devotee.; अकामाय काम-निवृत्तये मोक्ष-पर्यवसायिन इत्य् अर्थः ॥५०॥ — This means that they are devoted to liberation for the unwilling and for the renunciation of desire.
50.translation: Those desires are already present in Me, the solitary devotee. This means that they are devoted to liberation for the unwilling and for the renunciation of desire.

51.word_for_word: अनुवादेन वरान् दत्त्वा ताम् अभिनन्दति---उपलब्धम् इति । — He congratulates her by giving her gifts with a translation: “It’s available.; यद् यस्मान् मयि वर्तमाना धीर् नापकर्षिता नान्य-विषया जाता ॥५१॥ — That which caused the intellect to dwell in Me was not withdrawn nor became attached to any other object.
51.translation: He congratulates her by giving her gifts with a translation: “It’s available. That which caused the intellect to dwell in Me was not withdrawn nor became attached to any other object.

52.word_for_word: एकान्त-भक्तिम् अभिनन्द्य ताम् एव दृढीकर्तुं सकामान् भक्तान् निन्दति---ये माम् इति । — He praises solitary devotion and condemns those devotees who wish to strengthen it, saying, “Those who are devoted to Me.”; दाम्पत्ये दम्पत्य्-उपभोग्य-सुखार्थम् ॥५२॥ — For the enjoyment of the couple in marriage.
52.translation: He praises solitary devotion and condemns those devotees who wish to strengthen it, saying, “Those who are devoted to Me.” For the enjoyment of the couple in marriage.

53.word_for_word: माया-मोहितत्वम् एवोपपादयति---मां प्राप्य इति । — It only induces being deluded by illusion: having attained Me.; अपवर्गेण सह सम्पदो यस्मिन्, तं माम् । — In whom there is wealth with liberation, that is Me.; प्राप्य प्रसाद्य ये केवलं सम्पद एव विषयान् वाञ्छन्ति, न तु माम् । — Having obtained and appeased those who desire only wealth and objects, not Me.; तत्-पतिं तासां सम्पदाम् अपि योऽहम् एव पतिः, तम् । — I am the husband of that husband and of their possessions.; तथा ये विषया निरयेऽप्य् अतिनिकृष्ट-योनाव् अपि स्युः, तान् । — Similarly, those objects which may be even in the lowest sex in hell.; किं च, तेषां पुंसां मात्रात्मकत्वाद् विषयात्मकत्वान् निरयः सुसङ्गमः शोभन-सङ्गम् एव स्यात्, अतो मन्द-भाग्या एव ते इत्य् अर्थः ॥५३॥ — Moreover, since these men are matter-oriented and object-oriented, hell is a good association and only a beautiful association, and therefore they are only slowly fortunate, this means.
53.translation: It only induces being deluded by illusion: having attained Me. In whom there is wealth with liberation, that is Me. Having obtained and appeased those who desire only wealth and objects, not Me. I am the husband of that husband and of their possessions. Similarly, those objects which may be even in the lowest sex in hell. Moreover, since these men are matter-oriented and object-oriented, hell is a good association and only a beautiful association, and therefore they are only slowly fortunate, this means.

54.word_for_word: तस्मात् हे गृहेश्वरि ! — Therefore, O housewife!; त्वया मयि भव-मोचनी निष्काम्आनुवृत्तिः कृता । — You have made me follow you without desire, which is the liberation from this world.; एतद् दिष्ट्या भद्रम् । — This is fortunately good.; कथम्-भूता ? — How-ever?; खलैः सुदुष्करा, दुराशिषो दुरभिप्रायायाः, अत एव असुम्भरायाः प्राण-तर्पण-पराया निकृतिं जुषो वञ्चन-परायाः स्त्रियाः सुतराम् असाव् अनुवृत्तिर् दुष्करा इति ॥५४॥ — It is very difficult for the wicked to follow a woman who is not able to satisfy her life and who is devoted to deception and who is devoted to deception.
54.translation: Therefore, O housewife! You have made me follow you without desire, which is the liberation from this world. This is fortunately good. How-ever? It is very difficult for the wicked to follow a woman who is not able to satisfy her life and who is devoted to deception and who is devoted to deception.

55.word_for_word: किं च, सन्ति निष्कामाः प्रेम्णैव मय्य् अनुवर्तमाना बह्व्यः, किं तु त्वया सदृशीं क्वापि न पश्यामि इति तस्या भक्तिं बहु-मानेनाभिनन्दति---न त्वादृशीम् इति त्रिभिः । — Moreover, there are many who follow Me without desire, but I do not see anywhere like you, and he appreciates her devotion with great respect, saying, “No one like you.”; उपश्रुताः सत्यः कथा यस्य मे ॥५५॥ — The story of which I have heard is true
55.translation: Moreover, there are many who follow Me without desire, but I do not see anywhere like you, and he appreciates her devotion with great respect, saying, “No one like you.” The story of which I have heard is true

56.word_for_word: प्रोद्वाह-पर्वण्य् अनिरुद्ध-विवाहे । — On the occasion of the wedding ceremony, in the marriage of Aniruddha.; अक्ष-गोष्ठ्यां द्यूत-सभायाम् । — In the gambling assembly of the axes.; तस्य भ्रातुर् वधम् । — The murder of his brother.; तस्मिन् काले कालान्तरे वा तद्-अनुस्मरणतः पुनः पुनः समुत्थं दुःखम् अस्माभिर् अयोगो वियोगः, तद्-भीत्या असहः सोढवत्य् असि । — At that time or at a later time, you have endured the suffering that arose again and again from remembering Him, the unworthy separation from us, and unbearable for fear of Him.; अनेनैवानिरुद्ध-विवाहानन्तर्यम् अस्य ज्ञातव्यम् ॥५६॥ — This is the reason why he should be known after his marriage to Aniruddha.
56.translation: On the occasion of the wedding ceremony, in the marriage of Aniruddha. In the gambling assembly of the axes. The murder of his brother. At that time or at a later time, you have endured the suffering that arose again and again from remembering Him, the unworthy separation from us, and unbearable for fear of Him. This is the reason why he should be known after his marriage to Aniruddha.

57.word_for_word: अपि च दूत इति । — Also, it is a messenger.; आत्मलभने मत्प्राप्त्यर्थम् । — To find Me in finding yourself.; पयि चिरायति श्वोभाविनि विवाहे आगन्तव्यम् इति कृते समये कथञ्चिदप्राप्तवति सत्येतद्विश्वं शून्यं मत्वेदमनन्ययोग्यमङ्गं जिहासे त्यक्तुमिच्छामि त्यक्ष्यामीत्य् एवं दूतः प्रस्थापितः । — When the time had come for him to come to the wedding tomorrow, he sent a messenger saying, “Truly this world is empty.; तथा ह्य् उक्तं त्वया, यर्ह्य् अम्बुजाक्ष न लभेय भवत्-प्रसादं जह्याम् असून् व्रत-कृशान् शत-जन्मभिः स्यात् [भा।पु। — Thus you have said, if I do not obtain your grace, O lotus-eyed one, I shall give up these vow-lean ones for a hundred births [Bh.p.; १०। — 10. 10.; ५२.४३] इति । — 52.43] is.; यद् वा, अजिहास इति च्छेदः । — or, Ajihas, is a cut.; त्यक्तुम् ऐच्छ इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that he wants to give up.; तत् तव कर्म त्वय्य् एव तिष्ठेत्, न तत् प्रतिकर्तुं शक्यम् इत्य् अर्थः । — That means that your action will remain in you and cannot be reversed.; किं तु केवलं त्वां प्रतिनन्दयामो हर्षयाम इति ॥५७॥ — But we merely congratulate You and make You happy.
57.translation: Also, it is a messenger. To find Me in finding yourself. When the time had come for him to come to the wedding tomorrow, he sent a messenger saying, “Truly this world is empty. Thus you have said, if I do not obtain your grace, O lotus-eyed one, I shall give up these vow-lean ones for a hundred births [Bh.p. 10. 10. 52.43] is. or, Ajihas, is a cut. It means that he wants to give up. That means that your action will remain in you and cannot be reversed. But we merely congratulate You and make You happy.

58.word_for_word: सौरत-संलापैः सुरत-नर्म-गोष्ठीभिः ॥५८-५९॥ — They enjoyed pleasant conversations and jokes (58-59).
58.translation: They enjoyed pleasant conversations and jokes (58-59).
